sports.name: RRC 5th Annual Holiday Breakfast & Awards Celebration
sports.why: Great chance to socialize with fellow club members over breakfast and celebrate the year with awards and giveaways.
sports.summary: RRC’s 5th Annual Holiday Breakfast & Awards Celebration is a free morning gathering at Mel’s Drive-In (3355 Geary Boulevard) on December 13 at 8:30 AM featuring food, giveaways, superlative awards and a possible visit from Santa; attendees are asked to RSVP and to submit votes for awards via Meetup private message.

sports.name: Santa Skivvies 2026: Holiday Underwear Run Through the Castro (SF)
sports.why: To join a playful, community-driven charity run that includes a drag show and lively afterparty.
sports.summary: A holiday underwear run on Sunday, December 13, 2026 in the Castro: registration/check-in at 11:00–11:45 AM, a one-mile run through the neighborhood around noon, followed by a drag show, awards, and an afterparty at The Lookout; free to watch and a fundraiser for the San Francisco AIDS Foundation.

sports.name: Sunday Morning Run
sports.why: For a low-pressure, all-pace 5K and post-run coffee with a friendly group.
sports.summary: Community-organized weekly Sunday run meeting at 10:00 at the southeast corner of the Panhandle (near the William McKinley statue) for a 5K through Golden Gate Park; recommended pace is 10–15 min/mile.

sports.name: Unicycle Club Practice at Circus Center
sports.why: To learn or improve unicycling skills with provided equipment, clear safety rules, and a supportive group.
sports.summary: Community unicycle practice at Circus Center open to any skill level; participation is free (voluntary donations recommended) and Circus Center can provide a unicycle if you don’t bring one. Attendees must sign a paper waiver, those under 13 need a supervising adult, and everyone is required to have taken at least one unicycle class with Ying Ying Zhao before practicing.

sports.name: Wrestling at the Beach
sports.why: Practice grappling and conditioning outdoors on the sand in an all-skill-level setting.
sports.summary: A free beach wrestling meetup at Ocean Beach on 2026-12-13 at 13:00; any skill level is welcome, but RSVP is required and participants must agree to a release/waiver. Under-18s can attend only if accompanied by a parent or guardian who also signs up.
